note: Bytes moved per zone call. Multiplied by the MEASURED call count, never by an
assumed one - that is the whole point. The analyzer also checks measured
calls-per-forward against `n_per_forward` below and marks the traffic figure
unvalidated if they disagree, so a code change that moves a zone cannot
silently invalidate the model the way a hand-maintained table would.
Residency matters on this board: weights live in flash and are read through
the 16 KB XIP cache, activations live in SRAM. `flash_xip` and `sram` are
therefore reported separately rather than as one bandwidth number.

quant.why: Each call is one tm_gemm_head_q15: it streams one head slice of a Q12 weight matrix, HD*D int16 = 32*128*2 = 8192 B from flash. 48 calls per forward = 4 layers x (4 V + 4 Q + 4 K) head projections. 48 x 8192 = 393,216 B, which is the 384 KB 'KB0' row of optimisations/20_profiling_memory_compute.md, here derived from a measured call count instead of assumed. SRAM term is the Q15 activation read, S*D int16 x 2 (read a16, write the head buffer).

oproj.why: One core5 output projection per layer over the full D x D Q12 matrix: 128*128*2 = 32,768 B of flash. 4 calls = 131,072 B. SRAM: read S*D int16 context + write S*D fp32.

f1.why: First FFN GEMM, F x D Q12 = 128*128*2 = 32,768 B of flash per layer.

f2.why: Second FFN GEMM, D x F Q12 = 32,768 B of flash per layer. Note gelu is measured inside this zone, so f2's exclusive time excludes the activation but its weight traffic is unaffected.

attn_qk.closed_form: mean over i of (i+1)*HD*2 bytes = (S+1)/2 * HD * 2
attn_qk.why: Attention reads no weights - Q and K are activations already in SRAM. One call is one query row against the causal prefix, so bytes vary with the row index i and only the mean is meaningful: (S+1)/2 * HD * 2 = 64.5*32*2 = 4,128 B. Total over a forward is exact even though the per-call figure is an average, because the causal triangle S*(S+1)/2 is summed exactly. 2048 calls = 4 layers x 4 heads x 128 rows.

attn_pv.closed_form: mean over i of (i+1)*HD*2 bytes = (S+1)/2 * HD * 2
attn_pv.why: Same causal triangle as attn_qk, reading V rather than K.

attn_exp.closed_form: mean over i of (i+1)*2 bytes of int16 LUT-indexed scores
attn_exp.why: The integer exp LUT is 513 int16 entries and stays resident; the traffic is the score row itself, (i+1) int16 on average (S+1)/2*2 = 129 B read plus the same written back.

norm1.why: LayerNorm reads S*D fp32 and writes S*D, 65,536 B each way. Flash term is the gain/bias pair, 2*D fp32 = 1,024 B.

norm2.why: As norm1, on the post-attention residual.

final.why: The single trailing LayerNorm after the last layer.

res1.why: Residual add: two S*D reads plus one S*D write, 3 x 65,536 B.

gelu.why: In-place over the S*F Q15 buffer: 32,768 B read + 32,768 B written. The LUT is 513 int16 and stays cache-resident.

qkv.why: qkv is a bracket around quant calls plus the attention dispatch; its own traffic is attributed to quant, so counting it again here would double-count.

attn.why: attn brackets attn_qk / attn_exp / attn_pv; traffic is attributed to those children.
